levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: spots one in a few seconds

help.goal: Find more sets than anyone else. Everybody plays at the same time on the same cards — first to tap a set takes it.
steps: Look at the twelve cards. Each one has a number of symbols, a colour, a shape and a fill.
Tap three cards that make a set: for every one of those four features the three cards must be ALL the same or ALL different.
The third tap sends the call — a good one scores a point and the cards are replaced.
Keep going until the deck runs out.
notes: One example: one red empty diamond, two green empty diamonds, three purple empty diamonds — numbers all different, colours all different, shape and fill all the same. That is a set.
A wrong call locks your cards for five seconds while everyone else keeps playing, so look before you tap.
If no set is on the table, three more cards are dealt automatically — that is why you sometimes see fifteen or eighteen.
Play alone or add bots. A bot never calls a wrong set; the difficulty is how fast it spots one and how many it walks past.
